DataPortability.title: Data export & import
DataPortability.subtitle: Settings
DataPortability.exportDescription: Download a JSON backup of your builds, elements, conventions, planner tasks, and packing lists. Free for everyone — no upgrade required.
DataPortability.importInMobileApp: Restoring a backup file is not available on the web. Everything you edit here already saves to your Kyarafit account.
DataPortability.restoreReadOnly: Finish or undo your restore first.
DataPortability.accountExportNote: Includes builds, elements, events and day plans, packing lists, tasks and task groups, workflow links and templates, progress notes, photo references, legacy wardrobe records, your profile, groups you created and their event days, your memberships, follows, likes, comments, collaborations, activity, notification preferences, broadcasts you authored, and retained cloud-sync rows, conflicts and media references. Photo files, billing identifiers, push tokens and internal service state are not included.
DataPortability.localOnlyNotice: You're offline, so the export includes only what this browser holds: {count} item(s)
DataPortability.exportFailed: Couldn't load your data from your Kyarafit account, so nothing was downloaded. Check your connection and try again.

DeprecationBanner.label: Announcement
DeprecationBanner.title: Kyarafit is moving to Cosapp.si.
DeprecationBanner.body: We’re building Cosapp.si, a focused app for cosplay planning. It launches first on iOS, with Android and web planned, and Kyarafit stays up until Cosapp.si is on the web too. You’ll get an invite link on launch day, and we’re working on letting you bring your builds with you. Until then, everything here keeps working.
